Verify: program scope, eligibility, launch date. Sources: anthropic.com/news Sept 2026, Anthropic safety posts.

topics.angle: comparison|Compare on-device and cloud AI on privacy, cost, latency and capability.
topics.brief: Sections: the question (should this AI feature run on my device or in the cloud?); what's driving on-device AI in 2026 (privacy-conscious design, local processing in phones and smart homes, offline use); a comparison across privacy, latency, cost, model capability and battery; hybrid patterns (local first, cloud for heavy tasks); how to choose for a product or personal setup. Verify Gemini Gems-to-Skills migration dates and the 100-skill cap. Sources: https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/gemini/automate-tasks-with-skills/ and TechCrunch's Gems-to-Skills report.

topics.titleTr: Yapay Zekanin Yazdigi Arayuz Canliya Cikar mi?

topics.brief: Outline: what generative UI builders output (meta-framework/Next.js projects by default); the gap between a slick demo and production code (accessibility, keyboard/focus, state management, design tokens, error states, tests, security); a concrete hardening checklist to run before merge; when to refactor the generated code vs rewrite it from the spec; how to keep humans owning architecture and data flow while agents draft components; and the review habits that stop generated UI debt from compounding. Verify that generative builders default to meta-frameworks and the ~29%-of-code-is-AI-generated stat. Sources: https://blog.logrocket.com/8-trends-web-dev-2026/ and https://www.netguru.com/blog/front-end-trends.

topics.titleTr: Kismi On Render: Tek Sayfada Statik ve Dinamik

topics.brief: Outline: why 'static or dynamic' is a false choice; how Partial Prerendering serves a static shell with dynamic holes streamed in via Suspense boundaries; when it actually helps (mostly-static pages with a few personalized slots); caveats and current stability; what it means for caching and TTFB. Verify PPR behavior and its stability status in Next.js. Sources: Next.js docs (nextjs.org) and https://www.smartform.dev/blog/web-development-trends-2026-ai-first-typescript-edge.

topics.titleTr: Claude Code ve Codex ile Spec Odakli Kodlama
topics.titleEn: Spec-Driven Coding With Claude Code and Codex
topics.angle: how-to: write specs coding agents implement reliably
topics.brief: Outline: why written specs beat vibe-prompting once agents write most of the code; the anatomy of an implementable spec (acceptance criteria, file boundaries, data contracts, a test plan, explicit non-goals); how to hand that spec to Claude Code or Codex and let it plan before it edits; the review-and-iterate loop when the agent drifts; keeping the spec as living documentation the next agent reads; and the small-PR discipline that keeps changes reviewable. Verify the ~29%-AI-generated-code and ~68%-of-devs-use-AI claims. Sources: https://dhtmlx.com/blog/how-ai-is-reshaping-web-development-in-2026-javascript-frameworks-open-source-and-pm-tools/ and Anthropic's Claude Code docs/changelog.

Verify AI-generated-code share and the GitHub Copilot 55.8%-faster study figure. Sources: https://waveup.com/blog/top-19-ai-tools-for-startups-and-small-businesses/ and dhtmlx 2026 web-dev trends.

topics.titleTr: Kesintisiz Veritabani Gocu: Adim Adim
topics.titleEn: Zero-Downtime Database Migrations, Step by Step
topics.angle: story-led how-to: ship a schema change without downtime
topics.brief: Outline, framed around a near-miss on a live table: the expand-contract (parallel-change) pattern; ship additive schema changes first so old and new code both run; double-write to the new column while backfilling existing rows in small batches; feature-flag the read cutover and watch error rates; only then drop the old column in a separate destructive migration; how to roll back at each step; and the tooling (online-DDL, migration runners) that makes it safe. Verify expand-contract sequencing and backfill-batching best practices. Sources: PlanetScale and Stripe engineering write-ups on online schema changes.

topics.titleTr: Yapay Zeka FinOps: Token Harcamasini Gorunur Kil

topics.angle: data-led: attribute LLM/token cost to teams, products, and productivity
topics.brief: Outline: why AI spend escapes classic cloud FinOps (opaque token usage, managed services with no line items); tagging calls by team/feature via an LLM gateway and metering; unit economics (cost per request, per active user); connecting spend to outcomes/productivity; budgets and guardrails. Verify InfoQ's claim that AI token usage is a major unmanaged operational cost and the 73% platform-teams-added-AI figure. Sources: https://www.infoq.com/articles/cloud-devops-trends-2026/ and the FinOps Foundation.

topics.titleTr: OpenTelemetry ile LLM Cagrisi Nasil Izlenir?
topics.titleEn: How Do You Trace an LLM Call With OpenTelemetry?
topics.angle: how-to: instrument prompts, tokens, tool calls and latency with OTel
topics.brief: Outline: why LLM calls are a blind spot in normal tracing; the OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions and how they standardize this; creating spans for the prompt, completion, and each tool call; capturing token counts, model name, and cost as span attributes; linking an agent's multi-step run into one trace; sampling noisy high-volume traces without losing errors; exporting to a backend; and redacting sensitive prompt and PII content before it leaves your service. Verify the GenAI semantic-convention attribute names and current status. Sources: OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic-conventions docs (opentelemetry.io) and https://www.infoq.com/articles/cloud-devops-trends-2026/.

topics.titleTr: Kod Olarak Politika: Kubernetes'te OPA vs Kyverno
topics.titleEn: Policy as Code: OPA vs Kyverno for Kubernetes
topics.angle: comparison: which admission-control policy engine to adopt
topics.brief: Outline: what policy-as-code solves (guardrails, compliance, config-drift prevention) and why it matters as AI agents start opening PRs and changing infra; OPA/Gatekeeper with Rego vs Kyverno's Kubernetes-native YAML; the learning curve and tooling of each; authoring and unit-testing policies; enforcing at CI time vs at admission time in the cluster; mutation and generation rules; migration effort and operational cost; and a decision matrix for small teams. Verify current OPA Gatekeeper and Kyverno capabilities and CNCF status. Sources: Kyverno docs (kyverno.io) and Open Policy Agent docs (openpolicyagent.org).
